signal.title: Fetches remote code and runs it

explain.why: A release that shows remote-fetch-exec can change what runs on every request of your site. This text stands in for the detect lane's explain YAML, which the release links.
explain.how_to_review:
1. Open the flagged file at the line the finding names and read the code around it, including what calls it.
2. Compare with the changelog.
explain.false_alarms: A vendored library can show the same pattern.
explain.incidents: Example 2024: a plugin sold to a new owner shipped remote-fetch-exec.
